newsitem.title: CANADA: Foreigners sell Canada securities in November.
newsitem.headline: Foreigners sell Canada securities in November.

text.p: Foreign investors sold a net C$3.28 billion Canadian securities in November, after buying a net C$6.79 billion in October (revised from C$5.96 billion), Statistics Canada said on Thursday.
Canadian residents bought a net C$1.96 billion of foreign securities after buying C$1.52 billion in October (revised from C$1.23 billion).
